---
title: Add self-check questions to each phase
labels: content
---

**Why.** Each phase has a checkpoint list, but learners cannot test themselves against it without a teacher.

**Proposal.** Ten short questions per phase with answers kept on a separate page so they are not seen by accident. Mix recall and explain-it-in-your-own-words questions.

**Done when.** Phases 1 and 2 have questions and answers, and the checklist links to them.
